PART II

Item 7.Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Total net revenue increased 8 percent in 2025, driven by higher sales volume in construction equipment and favorable price realization, partially offset by unfavorable currency impacts. Demand for construction equipment remained strong in North America, supported by infrastructure spending. Dealer inventories increased during the year as dealers prepared for the spring selling season. Mining customers continued to invest in autonomous haulage and fleet replacement. Energy and transportation sales benefited from data center power generation projects. Sales volume growth and favorable price realization were the main drivers of the increase in revenue. Manufacturing costs were higher because of wage inflation and higher material costs, partly offset by freight savings.
